name: ga4gh-data-connect skill
summary: Query a GA4GH Data Connect endpoint (https://github.com/ga4gh-discovery/data-connect) by running a SQL search against its /search API, or list and browse its tables directly
description: Bundled Claude Code / MCP skill for GA4GH Data Connect, shipped alongside the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-ga4gh-data-connect` Cordis plugin and standalone MCP server in the `ga4gh-plugins` monorepo. Query a GA4GH Data Connect endpoint (https://github.com/ga4gh-discovery/data-connect) by running a SQL search against its /search API, or list and browse its tables directly. Use when the user asks to search, query, or run SQL against a GA4GH Data Connect service, wants to know what tables it holds, or mentions GA4GH data-connect interoperability.
